name: simple-get-json
author: Brett Zamir
description: getJSON function similar to that of jQuery's for Node or the browser

scripts.license-badge:
license-badger --corrections --uncategorizedLicenseTemplate "\${license} (\${name} (\${version}))" --filteredTypes=nonempty --textTemplate "License types
(project, deps, and bundled devDeps)" --packageJson --production badges/licenses-badge.svg
scripts.license-badges: npm run license-badge && npm run license-badge-dev
scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'disabling npm run license-badges for now' && npm run rollup
scripts.eslint-third-party-badge: eslint-formatter-badger --mainTemplate="ESLint 3rd party light audit (\${ruleMapCount} rules in \${numFiles} files)" --filteredTypes intrusive,vulnerability --ruleMap .eslintRuleTypeMap.json --outputPath badges/eslint-third-party.svg --noEslintInlineConfig --noUseEslintIgnore --noUseEslintrc --eslintConfigPath .eslintrc-3rdparty.cjs `es-file-traverse --file ./src/index.js --file ./src/index-polyglot.js --node`
scripts.eslint-badges: npm run eslint-badge && npm run eslint-third-party-badge
scripts.test: npm run eslint && npm run rollup && npm run mocha && npm run coverage-badge
scripts.browser-test: npm run eslint && npm run rollup && open-cli http://127.0.0.1:8089/test/index.html && npm start
